sections.heading: Texmap to Terrainoperator
sections.content:
The Terrain Warp operator can be used to convert a texture into a terrain grid.

Grid names: terrain grids with matching names will be affected.

sections.heading: Operation
sections.content: Operation: controls how the texmap height values will be integrated with existing grid height values.

sections.heading: Texture
sections.content:
Texmap: the texture map to derive the grid height values from.Amount: a multiplier applied to texture map values (which range from 0-1 by default), to convert them into grid height values.

sections.heading: Transform
sections.content: Transform texture with node: when enabled, the texture map will be transformed by the specified scene node, allowing for more controlled placement of it within the terrain grid bounds.
